text: Merhaba! Ben Namzu. Türkçe seslendirme bu cihazda çalışıyor.

installation.note: This inference run reused the existing approved installation; installMs is verification of that installation, not a download benchmark. Initial successful installation took about 51.16 seconds.

limitations: PCM drained to a file, not real speaker playback.
First-audio timing includes a cold worker.

Initial worker lacked explicit Python UTF-8 mode; Windows cp1252 corrupted Turkish input. See native-unicode-pipe-proof.json and native-cpu-proof-corrected.json. Retained as diagnostic evidence; not final speech quality proof.
